sn45.18:1.1: Evam me sutaṃ ekaṃ samayam āyasmā ca Ānando āyasmā ca Bhaddo Pāṭaliputte viharanti Kukkuṭārāme || || Atha kho āyasmā Bhaddo sāyaṇhasamayam paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yenāyasmā Ānando tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā Ānandena saddhiṃ sammodi || sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || || Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Bhaddo āyasmantam Ānandam etad avoca || ||
sn45.18:2.1: Abrahmacariyaṃ abrahmacariyanti āvuso Ānanda vuccati || katamaṃ nu kho āvuso abrahmacariyan ti || || Sādhu sādhu āvuso Bhadda bhaddako te āvuso Bhadda ummaggo bhaddakam paṭibhānaṃ kalyāṇī paripucchā || || Evaṃ hi tvam āvuso Bhadda pucchasi || || Abrahmacariyam abrahmacariyanti āvuso Ānanda vuccati || katamaṃ nu kho āvuso abrahmacariyan ti || || Evam āvuso ti || || Ayam eva kho āvuso aṭṭhaṅgiko micchāmaggo abrahmacariyaṃ || seyyathīdam || Micchādiṭṭhi || pa || micchāsamādhī ti || || 1.2.
